name: Streaming & Recording Pack

game_settings: Frame rate cap: Slightly above stream FPS (e.g., 90 FPS for 60 FPS stream)
Borderless Windowed: Recommended for easier alt-tabbing
In-game overlays: Disable to reduce CPU load
os_settings: Disable Windows Game DVR (conflicts with OBS)
driver_settings: Multi-display/mixed GPU mode: Disable if using single GPU
obs_settings: Encoder: NVENC (NVIDIA) or AMD VCE (AMD) - GPU encoding preferred
Preset: Quality or Max Quality (not Lossless)
Rate Control: CBR for streaming, CQP/CRF for recording
background_processes: Close Discord hardware acceleration (or use voice-only mode)
Set OBS process priority: Above Normal
Close RGB software, monitoring tools (unless needed for stream overlay)
Use single monitor if possible (reduces GPU load)
optiplay_tools: FPS Booster - Streaming Profile with encoder optimization
Network monitoring guide for stream health

revert_steps: Switch back to fullscreen if preferred
Windows Power Plan: Back to Balanced
Re-enable Windows Game DVR if used
encoder_priority: Best: Dedicated capture card + separate streaming PC
Avoid: CPU encoding on gaming PC (unless 12+ cores)
warnings: Single-PC streaming is demanding - even with GPU encoding
CPU encoding (x264) will severely impact FPS unless 16+ threads available
2-PC setup is ideal for serious streaming
Upload bandwidth matters: 10 Mbps+ recommended for 1080p60
Borderless windowed may cause slight FPS loss vs fullscreen
notes: Designed for single-PC streaming setups. Prioritizes GPU encoding to free up CPU for gaming. Frame cap prevents GPU bottleneck (100% GPU usage causes encoder lag). Best results with RTX 3060+ or RX 6700 XT+.
